name: thingtime-electron
description: Thingtime desktop app shell for the Remix/Nitro web app.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run verify:web && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run verify:web && electron .
scripts.dist: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run verify:web && electron-builder
scripts.dist:unsigned: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run verify:web && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never -c.mac.identity=null
